beforeImage.name: Landmark Dividend LLC
beforeImage.subsector: Ground leases and digital real estate
beforeImage.description: Landmark Dividend acquires, develops, and manages real-estate interests and infrastructure tied to wireless communications, data centers, outdoor advertising, and renewable-power sites. Its customer base includes tower operators, data-center users, enterprise customers, municipalities, faith-based organizations, and other landowners and infrastructure counterparties. The company follows an asset-heavy model focused on long-duration ground leases, digital real estate interests, and related infrastructure ownership structures. Public materials describe a portfolio of more than 5,000 assets and a business model centered on acquiring and managing mission-critical site interests. The platform has been part of DigitalBridge's digital infrastructure ecosystem and remains active across wireless, data-center, and adjacent infrastructure verticals. ADIA completed the acquisition of a 40% stake in Landmark in April 2024 alongside DigitalBridge-sponsored vehicles, with DigitalBridge retaining the balance.

afterImage.name: Landmark Dividend LLC
afterImage.subsector: Ground leases and digital real estate
afterImage.description: Landmark Dividend acquires, develops, and manages real estate and infrastructure tied to data centers, wireless communications, outdoor media, and renewable power. It serves landowners, corporations, municipalities, and institutions through ground-lease acquisitions and digital-infrastructure investment and operations. Official February 2026 materials describe more than 70 data centers under management and more than 160 employees. Landmark became a DigitalBridge portfolio company in June 2021; ADIA acquired a 40% interest in April 2024 alongside DigitalBridge-sponsored vehicles, and both ownership relationships remained identified by the company in February 2026.
